title: P2 persistent evaluated LoRA campaign and release proof
hypothesis: A frozen-base LoRA campaign can accumulate two multi-worker global steps across coordinator restart, improve a fixed held-out use case, and export a deterministic release that preserves separate base, adapter, worker-weight, and complete resume-state identities.

use_case.claim: Qualify persistent evaluated adapter progress and deterministic identity-separated releases before P3 native/offload work.

baseline.label: Zero-step rank-4 LoRA initialization
baseline.description: Evaluate the initial zero-B adapter on the same eight frozen validation sequences before any distributed global step.

primary_metric.label: Held-out mean-loss improvement
primary_metric.description: Initialization mean loss minus selected-checkpoint mean loss on eight frozen validation sequences.

repeated_validation_suite.label: Per-step held-out cross-entropy
repeated_validation_suite.description: Evaluate initialization and every completed global-step checkpoint on the same eight frozen validation sequences.

final_holdout_suite.label: No final holdout consumed
final_holdout_suite.description: This bounded P2 integration proof does not make a general model-quality claim and leaves final holdout assignment to a later campaign.

guardrails.label: Complete restart after step 1
guardrails.description: Reload after step 1 must preserve adapter, optimizer trajectory, cursor, history, and distinct weight/resume identities.

guardrails.label: Adapter trajectory parity
guardrails.description: The accepted step-2 adapter must remain within 1e-5 relative L2 of the centralized trajectory.

guardrails.label: Complete release checksum validation
guardrails.description: Every base, adapter, optimizer, state, dataset, dashboard, static worker, and manifest entry must pass SHA256SUMS verification.

independent_variables.label: Persistent evaluated adapter campaign
independent_variables.description: Advance from a connected one-step synthetic fixture to two versioned global steps, coordinator restart, fixed held-out evaluation, checkpoint selection, and deterministic release.

controlled_variables.label: Frozen base, adapter manifest, data, optimizer, and evaluation
controlled_variables.description: Hold the T0 base, rank-4 alpha-8 QKV adapter manifest, packed corpus, FP32 aggregation, coordinator AdamW, validation sequences, and checkpoint-selection rule fixed.
